src/kai_code/cli_ui.py.description: TokenTracker class exists with baseline_context, current_context, last_output tracking. Has set_baseline(), reset(), add(), display_last(), display_session() methods. Currently only displays on-demand via /tokens command.

src/kai_code/rich_ui/components/status_b.description: RichStatusBar component displays model, session, and YOLO mode in a Panel. Has render() method and update methods. This is where the token indicator will be integrated.

src/kai_code/model.py.description: Added get_context_limit(model_identifier: str) -> int function that retrieves context window limit for a model. Uses get_model_info() to look up model and returns context_window or DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW (128K) as fallback. Also added getContextLimit TypeScript-compat alias.

src/kai_code/models.json.description: Models now include context_window field with token limits: Claude 200K, GPT-4o/mini 128K, o1/o3 200K, Gemini 1M
